summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned customer home (/client-home): search bar + Book button, predictive suggestions, full-screen right-sliding BookingPanel, 4-step flow (property type -> describe/browse -> quotation type -> job details), browse navigation, job submit, /post-job regression, mobile/tablet layout. All flows work. One real bug found and FIXED: on mobile/tablet the booking panel did not cover the full screen (390px: x=16,w=374,h=812; 768px: x=208,w=560) because a global mobile dialog-clamp CSS rule in index.css applied to it. Added a :not([data-testid="booking-panel"]) exclusion; retested - panel now 390x844 and 768x1024, no horizontal overflow.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: index.css rule html[data-view-mode=mobile] [role=dialog] {max-width:min(560px,100vw-16px); max-height:100dvh-32px} clamped the full-screen panel so it did not cover the screen and the bottom nav showed through. Excluded booking-panel from the rule.

Hovering the mouse over the list sets the active item (onMouseEnter -> setActive). If the cursor is already where the list appears, typing free text and pressing Enter picks the hovered suggestion (e.g. 'fix my fence please' -> 'Fencing') and does not open the panel. Consider resetting active only from keyboard, or ignore hover until the mouse actually moves.

issues: Customer sidebar 'Post a Job' and mobile bottom-nav 'Post' still go to the classic /post-job form, not the new Book flow. This may be on purpose; check it against the user's request to merge the old Post a Job page with the new selections.

For the 'Heat Pump Installation' suggestion, switching to Commercial auto-detects 'Heat Pumps', but the 'Or did you mean' alternatives (Lighting Installation & Upgrades, EV Charger Installation) have nothing to do with it. This comes from how /services/detect ranks matches.
Not fully checked: the panel covered the whole 1920px browser instead of the phone frame. It is portalled to body, which is expected for portalled sheets.

action_items: Keep the index.css exclusion for booking-panel (or move the panel to a class like side-pane-sheet that the clamp rule already excludes)
Optional: stop mouse-hover highlight from hijacking Enter in ServiceSearch
Decide whether customer 'Post a Job' / bottom 'Post' should open the new Book flow
critical_code_review_comments: ServiceSearch: /services/detect is always called with service_type=residential, so detector boosts only reflect the residential taxonomy
JobRequestForm.jsx is 503 lines and holds both flow and page modes; consider splitting FlowMode/PageMode into separate components
Job detail page shows the category slug ('Plumbing-Gas') instead of category_name. This was already there before this change.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (1 bug fixed, 1 low-priority keyboard edge case)
